description: This file defines the class VTEntityData, a wrapper around CRMEntity instances, providing methods to instantiate entity data objects from various identifiers (entity ID, user ID, CRMEntity object), and to retrieve or set entity data and metadata.

classes.name: VTEntityData
classes.description: A wrapper around CRMEntity instances providing methods for entity data manipulation and retrieval.

methods.name: fromEntityId
methods.description: Creates a VTEntityData object from a given entity ID, loading entity information and associated module.

methods.name: fromUserId
methods.description: Creates a VTEntityData object from a given user ID, specifically for user entities.

methods.name: fromCRMEntity
methods.description: Creates a VTEntityData object from an existing CRMEntity object.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the entity's column fields as an array.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the entity.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module associated with the entity, with special handling for certain classes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets the value of a specific field in the entity.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific field in the entity.

methods.name: isSaved
methods.description: Checks whether the entity has been saved to the database.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Checks whether the entity data object is considered new.
